English · 简体中文
DeepSeek-Harness Widgets
The blank strip beside the conversation, as a grid of live cards — and one click to put it away.
61 cards: session · context · background jobs · the machine · quota and spend · peak pricing
Install each one, size it 2×2 or 2×4, tune it per instance, switch off what you do not watch; a macO
S-Dock-style magnification wave follows the pointer.
What it looks like once installed (click the left still for the motion: rail-demo.gif, 3.8 MB) · and
the market where every card is installed, sized and switched off.
**Install (30 seconds)** — paste these two lines to your DSH agent, or run them yourself:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
> No shell needed either way — say “**install the dsh-widgets plugin, restart web, then tell me**” t
o your DSH. The rail lives behind the **Widgets** icon in the session header; Settings → **Widgets**
installs, reorders and resizes the cards.
Works on DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6+` (0.1.x) and `0.2.0-rc.1+` (0.2.x).
**What you get** — 61 cards, yours to install, place and tune:
- **The session, live** — turns · steps, context level and compaction, tokens and cache hit rate, LL

M time, first-token latency, tool calls, background jobs and subagents;
- **Money and quota** — Open
Code Go's rolling / weekly / monthly windows; Command Code's 5-hour / weekly / monthly limits with o
ne tap to cycle the whole key pool, its credit balances, a month-end projection and today's budget;

## Features
## Architecture
- **Widget units + build-time discovery (ARCH-001)**: every widget is an independent unit under `src
/widgets/<id>/` — `manifest.json` (the machine-readable half: id / order / group / builtin / default
Installed / sizes / per-widget locale, plus an optional `source` + `skeleton`) + `index.ts` (the `de
fineWidget` descriptor: a **pure-data** `render()`, name/desc thunks, configSchema and example). The
registry is **generated**, never hand-maintained: `scripts/gen-registry.mjs` scans the unit dirs, r
ejects an unknown manifest key or a three-way id mismatch, and emits `src/client/generated.registry.
ts` (`WIDGETS` / `WIDGET_RUNTIME` / `ALL_IDS` / `ALL_INSTANCES` / `STATS_WIDGET_IDS` / `DEFAULT_INST
ALLED` / merged `WIDGET_LOCALES`). Adding a widget = adding one unit dir; `pnpm build` regenerates a
nd `pnpm check:registry` fails loudly when the registry is stale. The template lives in `src/widgets

-template/` — outside the scan root, so it can never be discovered or registered;
- **Contract**: `s
rc/client/lib/contract/` — `types.ts` (every shape a unit, a renderer or the shell exchanges; **zero
imports**, so a type-only consumer never pulls i18n or React into its graph) + `helpers.ts` (`defin
eWidget`, the label resolvers, the instance-key pair, `sizesOf`). The other framework-free helpers s
it beside it (`format.ts`, `heatmap-accounting.ts`, `quota-math.ts`, `morph-spring.ts`); per-source
payload parsing and that source's card renderers live in `src/client/families/<family>/{data,renders

}.ts`, and no family imports another;
- **Per-widget i18n**: widget strings live in each unit's `man
ifest.json` (family-shared strings once in `src/widgets/_shared/locales.json`); the shell dictionary
(`src/client/i18n.ts`) owns only the shell UI. The generated registry merges everything and the she

ll registers it with the official locale service at apply() time;
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` and later `0.1.x`, plus `0.2.0-rc.1` and later `0.2.x` — in the brow

ser and in the desktop app;
- Integrates via `conversation.input.overlay` / `conversation.session.he

ader.utilities` / `conversation.composer.dock` / `settings.section`;
- Coordinates explicitly with `
dsh-better-sidebar`'s right rail: the rail reads the official right-bar column (keeping `--dsh-sideb
ar-width` as a fallback for older better-sidebar builds) and its header capsule registers at `order:
5` so the two toggles cannot swap places on a bundle reload; no residue after uninstall.
### What's new — v1.8.5
**Six more cards, and the data behind every card now declares itself** — the registry goes from 55 u
s, and the data behind every card now declares itself** — the registry goes from 55 units to **61**:
- **The time family** — a **Clock** (analog or digital, six zones, a second hand that ticks), a **Ca
lendar** that dots the days DSH has a scheduled task on (2×2 month grid; the 2×4 adds the upcoming l
ist), a **Task Timer** for the running turn and what it is waiting on, a **Stopwatch** you can start

/ pause / reset, and a **Countdown** (duration capsules, or the next scheduled task);
- **DeepSeek
balance** — the official account balance with the ledger-derived day's spend beside it, reading a ho

st route of its own (`/api/deepseek-balance`), with the fold covered by a new offline gate;
- **A de
clared data-source contract** — a unit says what it reads (`reads`, `source`, its skeleton) and one
generic poller answers for all of them; the build now fails when a declaration drifts from the unit;
- **Four defects gone** — the hover wave no longer arms a whole row below the pointer on a rail ano
ther plugin has pushed down (45 checks: 25 FAIL → 45/45 PASS); the session-header anchor stops freez
ing when the shell swaps its node; the whole-card rule and the wheel's end detent read the same meas
ured inset — and `paneH` is measured at all, which it never had been; nvidia-smi's MiB are no longer

passed through as bytes;
- **The 设置 gear opens Settings → Widgets** — the app's own page, rather th
an a second panel of our own (that panel stays in the source as a reference, with nothing mounting i

t);
- **Two card standards with teeth** — `docs/design/CARD-BODY-POSTURE.md` and `CARD-TITLE-STANDAR
D.md`, both written from incidents that had already passed every gate, and both machine-asserted in

`scripts/probe-geometry.cjs`;
- **CI, and the offline gates to run in it** — `node scripts/gates.mjs
` (G1–G14) and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` running `pnpm run build` + `pnpm test` on every push and p
nd `.github/workflows/ci.yml` running `pnpm run build` + `pnpm test` on every push and pull request.
Each of these, with the measurement behind it, is written up in the CHANGELOG.
